verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.108
11. Clouds
Oxen
“Mendicants, there are these four kinds of oxen.
What four?
One hostile to its own herd, not others;
one hostile to other herds, not its own;
one hostile to both its own herd and others; and
one hostile to neither its own herd nor others.
These are the four kinds of oxen.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro balībaddūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, these four individuals similar to oxen are found in the world.
What four?
One hostile to their own herd, not others;
one hostile to other herds, not their own;
one hostile to both their own herd and others; and
one hostile to neither their own herd nor others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo?
verses.english: And how is an individual hostile to their own herd, not others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sakaparisaṁ ubbejetā hoti, no paraparisaṁ.
verses.english: It’s when an individual intimidates their own followers, not the followers of others.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is hostile to their own herd, not others.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo sagavacaṇḍo, no paragavacaṇḍo;
verses.english: That individual is like an ox that’s hostile to its own herd, not others.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo paragavacaṇḍo hoti, no sagavacaṇḍo?
verses.english: And how is an individual hostile to other herds, not their own?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo paraparisaṁ ubbejetā hoti, no sakaparisaṁ.
verses.english: It’s when an individual intimidates the followers of others, not their own. …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo paragavacaṇḍo hoti, no sagavacaṇḍo.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo paragavacaṇḍo, no sagavacaṇḍo;
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo ca hoti paragavacaṇḍo ca?
verses.english: And how is an individual hostile to both their own herd and others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sakaparisaṁ ubbejetā hoti paraparisañca.
verses.english: It’s when an individual intimidates their own followers and the followers of others. …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo ca hoti paragavacaṇḍo ca.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo sagavacaṇḍo ca paragavacaṇḍo ca;
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva sagavacaṇḍo hoti no paragavacaṇḍo?
verses.english: And how is an individual hostile to neither their own herd nor others?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo neva sakaparisaṁ ubbejetā hoti, no paraparisañca.
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t intimidate their own followers or the followers of others.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, balībaddo neva sagavacaṇḍo, no paragavacaṇḍo;
Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro balībaddūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These four individuals similar to oxen are found in the world.”
